findings.fix: scripts/import-core.mjs:271-280, the `@Damage[...]` branch of cleanDesc. The Foundry source is `@Damage[ternary(gte(@actor.system.skills.intimidation.rank,4),3,ternary(...,2,1))d4[mental]]`; the numeric guard `/^[\dd+\-\s()]+.../.test(formula)` rejects any non-plain formula and the handler returns '' — deleting the whole phrase. Measured over .import-src/pf2e/packs/pf2e: 680 @Damage tokens across 502 source documents are deleted to an empty string this way (producing "in a ," / "this deals ." / "take damage, with a against your class DC" across spells, items, feats and actions), and a further 1,459 tokens keep the dice but lose the damage TYPE because `inner.replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g,'')` strips the `[mental]` bracket. Make the non-plain branch fall back to the AoN mirror wording (or emit the lowest ternary arm) instead of '', and render the type bracket as a word. Reader: every description surface — src/sheet/RichText.tsx and DescBody — reads public/core-descriptions.json verbatim.
